name: Klamath Basin Forests and Watersheds Restoration
summary: Request for proposals from NFWF and USDA NRCS for forest, watershed and fish and wildlife habitat restoration and monitoring across the Klamath Basin in Oregon and California.

amount.note: Shasta Valley RCPP track; the Upper Klamath Watershed Resilience track has a $100,000-$500,000 range

steps: Call with NFWF programme manager (Shasta Valley RCPP only)

eligibility.rule: Not an international organization, business, individual, or U.S. federal agency
Locate the project within the target geography for its funding route
Keep Shasta project work outside the Shasta River Safe Harbor Agreement project list
Include an implementation component in a Shasta Valley RCPP project
Pair Shasta water-conservation projects with formal instream-flow protections
Shasta Valley RCPP: identify NRCS practices and keep costs within NRCS reimbursement rates
Do not fund ongoing efforts to comply with legal requirements

documents: NRCS Budget Template, completed for Shasta Valley RCPP, blank for the other funds
Statement of Litigation, unless a government applicant
Board of Trustees or Directors list, or a no-board statement
GAAP audited financial statements, unless current valid information is already on file
IRS Form 990, unless current valid information is already on file
Single Audit, unless current valid information is already on file

status.quote: Full Proposal Due Date February 9, 2027, by 8:59 PM PST

deadline.quote: Full Proposal Due Date February 9, 2027, by 8:59 PM PST

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include: non-profit 501(c) organizations, state government agencies, local governments, municipal governments, Tribal governments and organizations, special districts (e.g., conservation districts, planning districts, utility districts), and educational institutions.

geography.quote: fish and wildlife conservation, restoration, and monitoring projects across the Klamath Basin

access.quote: All application materials must be submitted online through National Fish and Wildlife Foundation's Easygrants system.

co_finance_required.quote: Match: Required - project must provide at least 25% match (for every dollar in grant funding, 25 cents in match funding is required). Match must be non-federal.

effort.quote: All applicants to the Shasta Valley RCPP must contact NFWF Program Manager Erica Engstrom-Schau (erica.engstrom-schau@nfwf.org, 415-490-5211) prior to proposal submission to discuss their project and review required supplemental budget and technical materials.
Full Proposal Due Date February 9, 2027, by 8:59 PM PST

eligibility.quote: Ineligible applicants include: international organizations, businesses, unincorporated individuals, or U.S. Federal government agencies.
Proposed projects must be located within the target geographic area of the Klamath Basin that is relevant to the funding for which they are applying.
Due to federal environmental compliance considerations, proposed project work must not be included within the Shasta River Safe Harbor Agreement project list.
Proposed projects must include an implementation component.

All funded water conservation projects under this program must be paired with formal measures to protect instream flows such as a state-approved instream flow dedication or signed forbearance agreement.
Applicants must identify the NRCS Conservation Practice(s) and Scenario(s) to be supported by their proposed project and confirm that their project costs will align with NRCS reimbursement rates.
NFWF funds may not be used to support ongoing efforts to comply with legal requirements, including permit conditions, mitigation, and settlement agreements.

co_finance.quote: Match: Required - project must provide at least 25% match (for every dollar in grant funding, 25 cents in match funding is required). Match must be non-federal.

documents.quote: The most important upload is your actual full proposal narrative.
Applicants for Shasta Valley Regional Conservation Partnership Program funding must complete and upload the NRCS Budget Template.
Applicants for Klamath Basin Restoration Program funding or Upper Klamath Watershed Resilience funding must upload a blank version of the NRCS Budget Template.

Statement of Litigation Yes Template provided in Easygrants online application "Uploads" section. Federal, state, and local government applicants are not required to complete this section. Board of Trustees or Directors Yes Provide a list of members. If your organization is not a nonprofit and does not have a Board, upload a document stating that none exists. GAAP Audited Financial Statements*
